offering_description.value: Provides economic, financial and litigation consulting to law firms, corporations and government bodies. Its experts analyze markets, damages and regulatory issues and testify in disputes, and it bills mainly for professional time or fixed-fee projects.

primary_services.value: expert testimony; litigation economics; antitrust and competition analysis; damages and valuation; regulatory economics

customer_segment.value: B2B: law firms, corporations, financial institutions, energy and healthcare companies; B2G: government agencies and regulators

end_markets.value: legal services; energy; healthcare; financial services; telecommunications; life sciences

revenue_model.value: service fees: professional fees for consulting and expert work, billed hourly or by fixed fee; project or contract: multi-month engagements for litigation support and regulatory proceedings

value_chain_position.value: service provider: sells expert analysis and testimony, using consultant staff, to law firms and companies

geography_served.value: global: offices across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: economic consulting practices in competition, litigation, regulation, energy, healthcare and finance sharing clients and experts

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: consultants and practice leaders selling directly to corporate and law firm clients

regulatory_exposure.value: low: only normal business rules apply, with professional and data privacy obligations
